text: Toolchain half is delivered in f61605f and verified with linalg JVM/JS 44 tests each plus fullLinkJS. Temporary sibling source bridge compiles Gale d510ed7 on both platforms but is intentionally uncommitted and cannot satisfy acceptance. Gale release policy explicitly forbids guessing the absent owner-selected license and canonical SCM route. Need owner choice of Gale license and canonical Git URL; an immutable Git commit/tag source pin can then avoid publishLocal and unblock carrier migration.
